notes.title: Test your reflexes. Dodge the chaos. Metal Head Warfare dares you! ⚡🔥
notes.notes:
💥 Event Description:
🎯 Metal Head Warfare isn't just another shooter.
It's a brutal test of raw reflexes, pure instinct, and metal-fueled madness!
[previewyoutube=vIe0P5qzjyo;full][/previewyoutube]
🕹️ Face a storm of bullets that feels like a hardcore drum solo.
Each run throws you into a new wave of chaos where dodging means surviving, and fighting back is an art.

🔥 Get ready to:

🛡️ Dodge hundreds (or thousands) of bullets
🔫 Collect insanely powerful weapons
🧠 Adapt and overcome enemy waves in procedurally generated levels

🎮 Are you into:

Insane bullet hells

Roguelite mechanics

Fast-paced arcade combat

That nostalgic shoot 'em up vibe?

Then this game is BUILT FOR YOU. And metal is your soundtrack.

📝 Add it to your wishlist now
📆 Available since March 21, 2025 – Only on Steam!
📢 Don’t forget to follow and share this page with your SHMUP-loving friends!
